# konnect_metering_feature (Resource)

MeteringFeature Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "konnect_metering_feature" "my_meteringfeature" {
  description = "...my_description..."
  key         = "resource_key"
  labels = {
    key = "value"
  }
  meter = {
    filters = {
      key = {
        and = [
          "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
        ]
        contains = "...my_contains..."
        eq       = "...my_eq..."
        exists   = false
        in = [
          "..."
        ]
        ncontains = "...my_ncontains..."
        neq       = "...my_neq..."
        nin = [
          "..."
        ]
        or = [
          "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
        ]
      }
    }
    id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
  }
  name = "...my_name..."
  unit_cost = {
    llm = {
      model               = "...my_model..."
      model_property      = "...my_model_property..."
      provider            = "...my_provider..."
      provider_property   = "...my_provider_property..."
      token_type          = "response"
      token_type_property = "...my_token_type_property..."
      type                = "llm"
    }
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) A key is a unique string that is used to identify a resource. Requires replacement if changed.
- `name` (String) Display name of the resource.

Between 1 and 256 characters.
Requires replacement if changed.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description of the resource.

Maximum 1024 characters.
Requires replacement if changed.
- `labels` (Map of String) Labels store metadata of an entity that can be used for filtering an entity list or for searching across entity types. 

Keys must be of length 1-63 characters, and cannot start with "kong", "konnect", "mesh", "kic", or "_".
Requires replacement if changed.
- `meter` (Attributes) The meter that the feature is associated with and based on which usage is
calculated. If not specified, the feature is static.
Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meter))
- `unit_cost` (Attributes) Optional per-unit cost configuration. Use "manual" for a fixed per-unit cost, or
"llm" to look up cost from the LLM cost database based on meter group-by
properties. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unit_cost))

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity creation date.
- `deleted_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity deletion date.
- `id` (String) ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier).
- `updated_at` (String) An ISO-8601 timestamp representation of entity last update date.

<a id="nestedatt--meter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meter`

Required:

- `id` (String) The ID of the meter to associate with this feature. Requires replacement if changed.

Optional:

- `filters` (Attributes Map) Filters to apply to the dimensions of the meter. Requires replacement if changed. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--meter--filters))

<a id="nestedatt--meter--filters"></a>
### Nested Schema for `meter.filters`

Optional:

- `and` (List of String) Combines the provided filters with a logical AND. Requires replacement if changed.
- `contains` (String) The attribute contains the provided value. Requires replacement if changed.
- `eq` (String) The attribute equals the provided value. Requires replacement if changed.
- `exists` (Boolean) The attribute exists. Requires replacement if changed.
- `in` (List of String) The attribute is one of the provided values. Requires replacement if changed.
- `ncontains` (String) The attribute does not contain the provided value. Requires replacement if changed.
- `neq` (String) The attribute does not equal the provided value. Requires replacement if changed.
- `nin` (List of String) The attribute is not one of the provided values. Requires replacement if changed.
- `or` (List of String) Combines the provided filters with a logical OR. Requires replacement if changed.



<a id="nestedatt--unit_cost"></a>
### Nested Schema for `unit_cost`

Optional:

- `llm` (Attributes) LLM cost lookup configuration. Each dimension (provider, model, token type) can
be specified as either a static value or a meter group-by property name
(mutually exclusive). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unit_cost--llm))
- `manual` (Attributes) A fixed per-unit cost amount. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unit_cost--manual))

<a id="nestedatt--unit_cost--llm"></a>
### Nested Schema for `unit_cost.llm`

Optional:

- `model` (String) Static model ID value (e.g., "gpt-4", "claude-3-5-sonnet"). Use this when the
feature tracks a single model. Mutually exclusive with `model_property`.
- `model_property` (String) Meter group-by property that holds the model ID. Use this when the meter has a
group-by dimension for model. Mutually exclusive with `model`.
- `provider` (String) Static LLM provider value (e.g., "openai", "anthropic"). Use this when the
feature tracks a single provider. Mutually exclusive with `provider_property`.
- `provider_property` (String) Meter group-by property that holds the LLM provider. Use this when the meter has
a group-by dimension for provider. Mutually exclusive with `provider`.
- `token_type` (String) Static token type value. Use this when the feature tracks a single token type
(e.g., only input tokens). `request` is an alias for `input`, `response` is an
alias for `output`. Mutually exclusive with `token_type_property`.
possible known values include one of ["input", "output", "cache_read", "cache_write", "reasoning", "request", "response"]
- `token_type_property` (String) Meter group-by property that holds the token type. Use this when the meter has a
group-by dimension for token type. Mutually exclusive with `token_type`.
- `type` (String) The type discriminator for LLM unit cost. Not Null; must be "llm"

Read-Only:

- `pricing` (Attributes) Resolved per-token pricing from the LLM cost database. Populated in responses
when the provider and model can be determined, either from static values or from
meter group-by filters with exact matches. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unit_cost--llm--pricing))

<a id="nestedatt--unit_cost--llm--pricing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `unit_cost.llm.pricing`

Read-Only:

- `cache_read_per_token` (String) Cost per cache read token in USD.
- `cache_write_per_token` (String) Cost per cache write token in USD.
- `input_per_token` (String) Cost per input token in USD.
- `output_per_token` (String) Cost per output token in USD.
- `reasoning_per_token` (String) Cost per reasoning token in USD.



<a id="nestedatt--unit_cost--manual"></a>
### Nested Schema for `unit_cost.manual`

Optional:

- `amount` (String) Fixed per-unit cost amount in USD. Not Null
- `type` (String) The type discriminator for manual unit cost. Not Null; must be "manual"

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = konnect_metering_feature.my_konnect_metering_feature
  id = "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import konnect_metering_feature.my_konnect_metering_feature "01G65Z755AFWAKHE12NY0CQ9FH"
```
